directives.name: AcceptInvalidSignatures
directives.description: Accept resources with invalid signatures.

directives.name: AccessControlAllowOrigins
directives.description: Comma separated list of origins that are allowed to make cross-origin requests

directives.name: AddOptionsToUrls
directives.description: Add query-params with configuration adjustments to rewritten URLs.

directives.name: AddResourceHeader
directives.description: Adds a custom HTTP header to every optimized resource the module serves. Repeatable, up to 20 headers.

directives.name: AdminDomains
directives.description: Access control for the per-host admin pages: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.

directives.name: AdminPath
directives.description: Set the admin path. Ex: /pagespeed_admin

directives.name: AgentOptimize
directives.description: Recognize Accept: text/markdown agent requests and add Vary: Accept on HTML. This flag is the only gate: no license or entitlement check sits behind it. 1.1 always serves optimized HTML (no markdown render).

directives.name: Allow
directives.description: Allows optimization of resources whose URL matches the wildcard. Later Allow and Disallow directives override earlier ones.

directives.name: AllowOptionsToBeSetByCookies
directives.description: Allow options to be set by cookies in addition to query parameters and request headers.

directives.name: AllowVaryOn
directives.description: Deprecated and ignored: in-place optimization no longer varies its output by request header.

directives.name: AnalyticsID
directives.description: Google Analytics ID to use on site.

directives.name: AsyncMetadataL2Writes
directives.description: Defer the metadata cache's blocking L2 (disk) write off the rewrite critical path onto a single-thread write-behind queue. Reads and the shared-memory L1 write stay synchronous, so same-machine read-your-writes is preserved. Experimental; off by default.

directives.name: AvifAnimatedRecompressionQuality
directives.description: Quality for rewritten animated avif images [-1,100], 100 refers to best quality, -1 uses ImageRecompressionQuality.

directives.name: AvifQualityForSaveData
directives.description: Set quality for the images which will be optimized to lossy AVIF format in the Save-Data mode. Use a value in [0,100] to explicitly set the quality. Use -1 to ignore the Save-Data header.

directives.name: AvifRecompressionQuality
directives.description: Quality for rewritten avif images [-1,100], 100 refers to best quality, -1 uses ImageRecompressionQuality.

directives.name: AvifRecompressionQualityForSmallScreens
directives.description: Quality for rewritten avif images for small screens. [-1,100], 100 refers to best quality, -1 falls back to AvifRecompressionQuality.

directives.name: AvifTimeoutMs
directives.description: Timeout for AVIF still-image encoding, in milliseconds; the encoder speed is derived from this budget.

directives.name: AvoidRenamingIntrospectiveJavascript
directives.description: Don't combine, inline, cache extend, or otherwise modify javascript in ways that require changing the URL if we see introspection in the form of document.getElementsByTagName('script').

directives.name: BeaconReinstrumentTimeSec
directives.description: How often (in seconds) to reinstrument pages with beacons. This is used for both critical image beaconing, and for the prioritize_critical_css filter.

directives.name: BeaconUrl
directives.description: URL for beacon callback injected by add_instrumentation.

directives.name: BlockingRewriteKey
directives.description: If the X-PSA-Pagespeed-Blocking-Rewrite header is present, and its value matches the configured value, ensure that all rewrites are completed before sending the response to the client.

directives.name: BlockingRewriteRefererUrls
directives.description: wildcard_spec for referer urls which trigger blocking rewrites

directives.name: CacheFlushFilename
directives.description: Name of file to check for timestamp updates used to flush cache. This file will be relative to the ModPagespeedFileCachePath if it does not begin with a slash.

directives.name: CacheFlushPollIntervalSec
directives.description: Number of seconds to wait between polling for cache-flush requests

directives.name: CacheFragment
directives.description: Set a cache fragment to allow servers with different hostnames to share a cache. Allowed: letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.

directives.name: ClearInheritedScripts
directives.description: Drops the script-variable directive lines inherited from the enclosing block, so this block starts from the non-scripted configuration.

directives.name: ClientDomainRewrite
directives.description: Allow rewrite_domains to rewrite urls on the client side.

directives.name: CollectRefererStatistics
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: CombineAcrossPaths
directives.description: Allow combining resources from different paths

directives.name: CompressMetadataCache
directives.description: Whether to compress cache entries before writing them to memory or disk.

directives.name: ConsoleDomains
directives.description: Access control for the console page: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.

directives.name: ConsolePath
directives.description: Set the console path. Ex: /pagespeed_console

directives.name: ContentExperimentID
directives.description: Which Google Analytics content experiment to log to.

directives.name: ContentExperimentVariantID
directives.description: Which Google Analytics content experiment variant to log to.

directives.name: CreateSharedMemoryMetadataCache
directives.description: Creates a named shared-memory metadata cache of the given size for the virtual hosts whose FileCachePath is that name.

directives.name: CriticalCssAboveTheFoldOnly
directives.description: Makes prioritize_critical_css inline only the rules for content in the first screen instead of the rules for the whole page. The inline block is smaller; content further down may be shown partly styled until the full stylesheet has arrived.

directives.name: CriticalImagesBeaconEnabled
directives.description: Enable insertion of client-side critical image detection js for image optimization filters.

directives.name: CssFlattenMaxBytes
directives.description: Number of bytes below which stylesheets will be flattened.

directives.name: CssImageInlineMaxBytes
directives.description: Number of bytes below which CSS images will be inlined.

directives.name: CssInlineMaxBytes
directives.description: Number of bytes below which stylesheets will be inlined.

directives.name: CssOutlineMinBytes
directives.description: Number of bytes above which inline CSS resources will be outlined.

directives.name: CssPreserveURLs
directives.description: Disable the rewriting of CSS URLs.

directives.name: CustomFetchHeader
directives.description: Adds a request header to every fetch the module makes to an origin.

directives.name: CycloneRamCacheKb
directives.description: Set the size, in KB, of Cyclone's internal RAM cache tier, decoupled from LRUCacheKbPerProcess. 0 (the default) disables the RAM tier -- reads are served from the memory-mapped volume, which the OS page cache already keeps hot; -1 inherits LRUCacheKbPerProcess.

directives.name: CycloneZeroCopy
directives.description: Serve HTTP cache hits directly from the Cyclone cache's memory-mapped storage without copying the payload (zero-copy). Off by default on every port; set it on explicitly to opt in.

directives.name: CycloneZeroCopyServe
directives.description: Carry memory-mapped Cyclone cache-hit bytes into the port output buffer by reference (aliased) instead of copying them; the serve safely copies the tail out before a cache eviction can overwrite it. Engages only once CycloneZeroCopy maps cache values; on Apache the aliased serve is experimental and activates only when this option is explicitly set. Apache aliases only plain-HTTP/1.x main-request 200s of at least 16KB served verbatim (no Range, no deflate/ssl/http2 or other transforming filter), and bytes an output filter parks for a slow client are copied out at that point; everything else serves a verified copy.

directives.name: DaemonApiSocketPath
directives.description: Path of the optimizer daemon's management API unix socket, backing the /v1/daemon/* admin endpoints. Empty disables them. This is a different socket from DaemonSocketPath (the notification socket).

descriptionByPlatform.nginx: Set the unix socket path of the optimizer daemon's management API, backing the /v1/daemon/* admin endpoints. Empty disables them.

directives.name: DaemonServeStoredEncodings
directives.description: Serve the optimizer daemon's stored gzip and brotli copies of stylesheets, scripts and SVG images to clients that accept them, labelled with Content-Encoding, instead of compressing the uncompressed copy on the way out. Default off.

directives.name: DaemonSocketPath
directives.description: Path of the optimizer daemon's notification socket. Set this together with DaemonVolumePath to hand in-place optimization to the daemon; leave both unset to keep the classic in-place path.

descriptionByPlatform.nginx: Path of the optimizer daemon's notification socket. Set this together with DaemonVolumePath; leave both unset to keep the classic in-place path. With both set, the nginx port records through the daemon and serves the optimized copies from its shared cache. See docs/install-nginx.md.

directives.name: DaemonVolumePath
directives.description: Path of the optimizer daemon's shared cache volume. Keep this on a DIFFERENT path from FileCachePath. Set this together with DaemonSocketPath; leave both unset to keep the classic in-place path.

descriptionByPlatform.nginx: Path of the optimizer daemon's shared cache volume. Keep this on a DIFFERENT path from FileCachePath. Set this together with DaemonSocketPath; leave both unset to keep the classic in-place path. With both set, the nginx port records through the daemon and serves the optimized copies from its shared cache. See docs/install-nginx.md.

directives.name: DangerPermitFetchFromUnknownHosts
directives.description: Disable security checks that prohibit fetching from hostnames mod_pagespeed does not know about

directives.name: DefaultSharedMemoryCacheKB
directives.description: Size of the default shared memory cache used by all virtual hosts that don't use CreateSharedMemoryMetadataCache. Set to 0 to turn off the default shared memory cache.

directives.name: DisableBackgroundFetchesForBots
directives.description: Disable pre-emptive background fetches on bot requests.

directives.name: DisableFilters
directives.description: Comma-separated list of disabled filters

directives.name: DisableForBots
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: DisableRewriteOnNoTransform
directives.description: If false, resource is rewritten even if no-transform header is set

directives.name: Disallow
directives.description: Excludes resources (and pages) whose URL matches the wildcard from optimization.

directives.name: DistributedRewriteKey
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: DistributedRewriteServers
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: DistributedRewriteTimeoutMs
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: DistributeFetches
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: Domain
directives.description: Authorizes the module to fetch and rewrite resources on this domain.

directives.name: DomainRewriteCookies
directives.description: Allow rewrite_domains to rewrite domains in Set-Cookie headers.

directives.name: DomainRewriteHyperlinks
directives.description: Allow rewrite_domains to rewrite <form> and <a> tags in addition to resource tags.

directives.name: DownstreamCachePurgeLocationPrefix
directives.description: The host:port/path prefix to be used for purging requests from the downstream cache.

directives.name: DownstreamCachePurgeMethod
directives.description: Method to be used for purging responses from the downstream cache

directives.name: DownstreamCacheRebeaconingKey
directives.description: The key used to authenticate rebeaconing requests from downstream caches. The value specified for this key in the pagespeed server config should be used in the caching layer configuration also.

directives.name: DownstreamCacheRewrittenPercentageThreshold
directives.description: Threshold for percentage of rewriting to be finished before the response is served out and simultaneously stored in the downstream cache, beyond which the response will not be purged from the cache evenif more rewriting is possible now

directives.name: EnableAggressiveRewritersForMobile
directives.description: Allows defer_javascript and defer_iframe for mobile browsers

directives.name: EnableCachePurge
directives.description: Allows individual resources to be flushed; adding some overhead to the metadata cache

directives.name: EnableDeferJsExperimental
directives.description: Enable experimental options in defer javascript.

directives.name: EnableExtendedInstrumentation
directives.description: If set to true, addition instrumentation js is added to that page that the beacon can collect more information.

directives.name: EnableFilters
directives.description: Comma-separated list of enabled filters

directives.name: EnrollExperiment
directives.description: Assign users to a specific experiment setting.

directives.name: ExperimentalCentralControllerPort
directives.description: Deprecated and ignored: the experimental gRPC central controller was removed

directives.name: ExperimentalMeasurementProxy
directives.description: Experimental measurement proxy mode (Apache only).

directives.name: ExperimentalPopularityContestMaxInFlight
directives.description: Deprecated and ignored: the experimental gRPC central controller was removed

directives.name: ExperimentalPopularityContestMaxQueueSize
directives.description: Deprecated and ignored: the experimental gRPC central controller was removed

directives.name: ExperimentalProxyAllRequests
directives.description: Experimental mode where mod_pagespeed acts entirely as a proxy, and doesn't attempt to work with any local serving.

directives.name: ExperimentSpec
directives.description: Configuration for one side of an experiment in the form: 'id= ;enabled= ;disabled= ;ga= ;percent= ...'

directives.name: ExperimentVariable
directives.description: Specify the custom variable slot with which to run experiments.Defaults to 1.

directives.name: FetcherTimeOutMs
directives.description: Set internal fetcher timeout in milliseconds

directives.name: FetchFromModSpdy
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: FetchHttps
directives.description: Controls direct fetching of HTTPS resources. Value is comma-separated list of keywords: enable,disable,allow_self_signed,allow_unknown_certificate_authority,allow_certificate_not_yet_valid

directives.name: FetchProxy
directives.description: Set the fetch proxy

directives.name: FetchWithGzip
directives.description: Request http content from origin servers using gzip

directives.name: FileCacheCleanIntervalMs
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: FileCacheInodeLimit
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: FileCachePath
directives.description: Set the path for file cache

directives.name: FileCacheSizeKb
directives.description: Set the target size (in kilobytes) for file cache

directives.name: FileCacheSmallTierPercent
directives.description: Percentage of the file cache carved out as a separate small-object volume that protects metadata and property entries from payload churn. 0 disables the tier; values are clamped to [0, 50]. Below roughly 256 MB of total file cache the tier disables itself and entries share the main volume. Applies in the default shared-memory metadata cache configuration; with the shm metadata cache disabled, metadata stays on the main volume.

directives.name: FinderPropertiesCacheExpirationTimeMs
directives.description: Number of ms that beacon results for the critical selector finders should be considered valid.

directives.name: FlushHtml
directives.description: Enable auto-flush heuristics for HTML in full proxy mode

directives.name: FollowFlushes
directives.description: Attempt to mirror incoming flushes for html streams in the output when ProxyFetch is used.

directives.name: ForbidAllDisabledFilters
directives.description: Prevents the use of disabled filters

directives.name: ForbidFilters
directives.description: Comma-separated list of forbidden filters

directives.name: ForceBuffering
directives.description: Force buffering of non-html fetch responses rather than streaming

directives.name: ForceCaching
directives.description: Ignore HTTP cache headers and TTLs

directives.name: GeneratedFilePrefix
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: GlobalAdminDomains
directives.description: Access control for the global admin pages: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.

directives.name: GlobalAdminPath
directives.description: Set the global admin path. Ex: /pagespeed_global_admin

directives.name: GlobalStatisticsDomains
directives.description: Access control for the global statistics page: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.

directives.name: GlobalStatisticsPath
directives.description: Set the global statistics path. Ex: /ngx_pagespeed_global_statistics

directives.name: GoogleFontCssInlineMaxBytes
directives.description: Number of bytes below which Google Font stylesheets will be inlined.

directives.name: HashRefererStatistics
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: HideRefererUsingMeta
directives.description: Hides the referer by adding meta tag to the HTML

directives.name: HonorCsp
directives.description: Controls whether PageSpeed should pay attention to Content-Security-Policy directives

directives.name: HttpCacheCompressionLevel
directives.description: Compression level for HTTPCache. [-1-9] where 0 is off, 1 is minimumcompression, and 9 (the default) is maximum compression.

directives.name: If
directives.description: Conditionally apply some mod_pagespeed options. Possible arguments: spdy, !spdy

directives.name: ImageInlineMaxBytes
directives.description: Number of bytes below which images will be inlined.

directives.name: ImageJpegNumProgressiveScans
directives.description: Number of progressive scans [1,10] to emit when rewriting images as ten-scan progressive jpegs. A value of -1 outputs all progressive scans.

directives.name: ImageJpegNumProgressiveScansForSmallScreens
directives.description: Number of progressive scans [1,10] to emit when rewriting images asten-scan progressive jpegs for small screens. A value of -1 falls back to kImageJpegNumProgressiveScans.

directives.name: ImageLimitOptimizedPercent
directives.description: Replace images whose size after recompression is less than the given percent of original image size; 100 means replace if smaller.

directives.name: ImageLimitRenderedAreaPercent
directives.description: Limit on percentage of rendered image wxh to the original image wxh that should be stored in the property cache. This is to avoid corner cases where rounding off decreases the rendered image size by a few pixels.

directives.name: ImageLimitResizeAreaPercent
directives.description: Consider resizing images whose area in pixels is less than the given percent of original image area; 100 means replace if smaller.

directives.name: ImageMaxRewritesAtOnce
directives.description: Set bound on number of images being rewritten at one time (0 = unbounded).

directives.name: ImagePreserveURLs
directives.description: Disable the rewriting of Image URLs.

directives.name: ImageProvenanceCarry
directives.description: Provenance carry-through: when true (and PreserveImageProvenance is on), PNG images carrying a C2PA / Content Credentials manifest are recompressed AND their original manifest chunks (caBX/iTXt) are carried into the optimized output unmodified, keeping both the byte savings and the provenance. (Manifest-bearing JPEGs already carry their APP11/JUMBF through recompression under PreserveImageProvenance.) Cases where the carrier cannot be preserved byte-exactly -- resize, format conversion (PNG->JPEG/WebP), GIF, or extraction failure -- fall back to the default detect-and-skip pass-through. No effect when PreserveImageProvenance is false.

directives.name: ImageRecompressionQuality
directives.description: Set quality parameter for recompressing images [-1,100], 100 refers to best quality, -1 disables lossy compression. JpegRecompressionQuality and WebpRecompressionQuality override this.

directives.name: ImageResolutionLimitBytes
directives.description: Maximum byte size of an image for optimization

directives.name: ImageWebpRecompressionQuality
directives.description: Former name of WebpRecompressionQuality; accepted and mapped to it.

directives.name: ImageWebpRecompressionQualityForSmallScreens
directives.description: Former name of WebpRecompressionQualityForSmallScreens; accepted and mapped to it.

directives.name: ImgInlineMaxBytes
directives.description: Former name of ImageInlineMaxBytes; accepted and mapped to it.

directives.name: ImgMaxRewritesAtOnce
directives.description: Former name of ImageMaxRewritesAtOnce; accepted and mapped to it.

directives.name: ImplicitCacheTtlMs
directives.description: Time in milliseconds to cache resources that lack an Expires or Cache-Control header

directives.name: IncreaseSpeedTracking
directives.description: Increase the percentage of sites that have Google Analytics page speed tracking

directives.name: InheritVHostConfig
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: InlineOnlyCriticalImages
directives.description: Inline only critical images

directives.name: InlineResourcesWithoutExplicitAuthorization
directives.description: Specifies the resource types that can be inlined into HTML even if they do not belong to explicitly authorized domains.

directives.name: InPlacePreemptiveRewriteCss
directives.description: If set, issue preemptive rewrites of CSS on the HTML path when configured to use IPRO.

directives.name: InPlacePreemptiveRewriteCssImages
directives.description: If set, issue preemptive rewrites of CSS images on the IPRO serving path.

directives.name: InPlacePreemptiveRewriteImages
directives.description: If set, issue preemptive rewrites of images on the HTML path when configured to use IPRO.

directives.name: InPlacePreemptiveRewriteJavascript
directives.description: If set, issue preemptive rewrites of JS on the HTML path when configured to use IPRO.

directives.name: InPlaceResourceOptimization
directives.description: Allow rewriting resources even when they are fetched over non-pagespeed URLs.

directives.name: InPlaceRewriteDeadlineMs
directives.description: Time to wait for an in-place resource optimization beforefalling back to the original resource for the request.

directives.name: InPlaceSMaxAgeSec
directives.description: What to set s-maxage to on not-yet-optimized ipro resources

directives.name: InPlaceWaitForOptimized
directives.description: Wait for optimizations to complete

directives.name: InstallCrashHandler
directives.description: Try to dump backtrace on crashes. For developer use

directives.name: IproMaxConcurrentRecordings
directives.description: Limit allowed number of IPRO recordings

directives.name: IproMaxResponseBytes
directives.description: Limit allowed size of IPRO responses. Set to 0 for unlimited.

directives.name: JpegQualityForSaveData
directives.description: Set quality for the images which will be optimized to JPEG format in the Save-Data mode. Use a value in [0,100] to explicitly set the quality. Use -1 to ignore the Save-Data header.

directives.name: JpegRecompressionQuality
directives.description: Set quality parameter for recompressing jpeg images [-1,100], 100 is lossless, -1 uses ImageRecompressionQuality

directives.name: JpegRecompressionQualityForSmallScreens
directives.description: Set quality parameter for recompressing jpeg images for small screens. [-1,100], 100 refers to best quality, -1 falls back to ImageJpegRecompressionQuality.

directives.name: JsInlineMaxBytes
directives.description: Number of bytes below which javascript will be inlined.

directives.name: JsOutlineMinBytes
directives.description: Number of bytes above which inline Javascript resources willbe outlined.

directives.name: JsPreserveURLs
directives.description: Disable the rewriting of Javascript URLs.

directives.name: LazyloadImagesAfterOnload
directives.description: Wait until page onload before loading lazy images

directives.name: LazyloadImagesBlankUrl
directives.description: URL of image used to display prior to loading the lazy image. Empty means use a site-local copy.

directives.name: LazyloadImagesMode
directives.description: How to lazyload images: 'native' annotates non-critical images with loading="lazy", 'js' uses the JavaScript loader, and 'auto' (the default) picks per user agent.

directives.name: LazyloadImagesSkipFirst
directives.description: Number of leading images to leave untouched when critical image data is unavailable, protecting likely LCP candidates.

directives.name: Library
directives.description: Recognizes a JavaScript library by size and hash so canonicalize_javascript_libraries can replace it with the given canonical URL.

directives.name: ListOutstandingUrlsOnError
directives.description: Adds an error message into the log for every URL fetch in flight when the HTTP stack encounters a system error, e.g. Connection Refused

directives.name: LoadFromFile
directives.description: Serves resources under a URL prefix straight from the filesystem instead of fetching them over HTTP.

directives.name: LoadFromFileCacheTtlMs
directives.description: Time in milliseconds to cache resources loaded from file that lack an Expires or Cache-Control header. If not explicitly set, defaults to using the value set by implicit_cache_ttl_ms

directives.name: LoadFromFileMatch
directives.description: LoadFromFile with a regular expression on the URL and a replacement filename prefix.

directives.name: LoadFromFileRule
directives.description: Allows or disallows loading from file for a filename prefix after a LoadFromFile mapping.

directives.name: LoadFromFileRuleMatch
directives.description: LoadFromFileRule with a regular expression on the filename.

directives.name: LogDir
directives.description: Directory to store logs in.

directives.name: LogMobilizationSamples
directives.description: Verbose debugging of all sample data generated by mobilization_label_filter.

directives.name: LogRewriteTiming
directives.description: Whether or not to report timing information about HtmlParse.

directives.name: LogUrlIndices
directives.description: Whether or not to log URL indices for rewriter applications.

directives.name: LowercaseHtmlNames
directives.description: Lowercase tag and attribute names for HTML.

directives.name: LRUCacheByteLimit
directives.description: Set the maximum byte size entry to store in the per-process in-memory LRU cache

directives.name: LRUCacheKbPerProcess
directives.description: Set the total size, in KB, of the per-process in-memory LRU cache

directives.name: MapOriginDomain
directives.description: Fetches resources for the public domain(s) from the origin domain instead, optionally sending a different Host header.

directives.name: MapProxyDomain
directives.description: Proxies and optimizes resources from a separate origin domain under a path of this site.

directives.name: MapRewriteDomain
directives.description: Rewrites optimized resource URLs from the listed domains onto another domain (for example a CDN hostname).

directives.name: MaxCacheableContentLength
directives.description: Maximum length of a cacheable response content. To remove this limit, use -1.

directives.name: MaxCombinedCssBytes
directives.description: Maximum size allowed for the combined CSS resource.

directives.name: MaxCombinedJsBytes
directives.description: Maximum size allowed for the combined JavaScript resource.

directives.name: MaxHtmlParseBytes
directives.description: Maximum number of bytes of HTML that we parse, before redirecting to ?ModPagespeed=off

directives.name: MaxImageSizeLowResolutionBytes
directives.description: Maximum image size below which low resolution image is generated.

directives.name: MaxInlinedPreviewImagesIndex

directives.name: MaxPrefetchJsElements
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: MaxSegmentLength
directives.description: Maximum size of a URL segment.

directives.name: MemcachedServers
directives.description: Comma-separated list of servers e.g. host1:port1,host2:port2

directives.name: MemcachedThreads
directives.description: Number of background threads to use to run memcached fetches

directives.name: MemcachedTimeoutUs
directives.description: Maximum time in microseconds to allow for memcached transactions

directives.name: MessageBufferSize
directives.description: Size in bytes of the in-memory message history shown on the messages page; 0 disables it.

directives.name: MessagesDomains
directives.description: Access control for the message history page: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.

directives.name: MessagesPath
directives.description: Set the messages path. Ex: /ngx_pagespeed_message

directives.name: MinImageSizeLowResolutionBytes
directives.description: Minimum image size above which low resolution image is generated.

directives.name: ModifyCachingHeaders
directives.description: Set to false to disallow mod_pagespeed from editing HTML Cache-Control headers. This is not safe in general and can cause the incorrect versions of HTML to be served to users.

directives.name: ModPagespeed
directives.description: The module switch. on optimizes; standby serves already-optimized .pagespeed. resources and answers query-parameter requests but optimizes no new traffic; unplugged intercepts nothing (on nginx, off is an alias for unplugged). unplugged can only be set at the top level or in a virtual host. nginx needs an explicit pagespeed on; in the server block.

directives.name: NativeFetcherMaxKeepaliveRequests
directives.description: Maximum number of requests the native fetcher sends over one keep-alive connection before it opens a new one (a positive integer).

directives.name: Noop
directives.description: Meaningless integer option for browser cache-busting in query-params

directives.name: NoTransformOptimizedImages
directives.description: Add no-transform header to cache-control for optimized images

directives.name: NumExpensiveRewriteThreads
directives.description: Threads per process for heavy optimization work such as image transcoding. auto (or 0) sizes the pool from the CPUs the process may use; a positive integer sets it exactly.

directives.name: NumRewriteThreads
directives.description: Threads per process for short, latency-sensitive optimization work. auto (or 0) sizes the pool from the CPUs the process may use; a positive integer sets it exactly.

directives.name: NumShards
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: OptionCookiesDurationMs
directives.description: The max-age in ms of cookies that set PageSpeed options.

directives.name: PermitIdsForCssCombining
directives.description: Allow combining CSS files with IDs matching wildcard

directives.name: PreserveImageProvenance
directives.description: Preserve C2PA/Content-Credentials provenance metadata (JPEG APP11/JUMBF) through image optimization. On by default; independent of EXIF stripping.

directives.name: PreserveSubresourceHints
directives.description: Keep original subresource hints in place.

directives.name: PreserveUrlRelativity
directives.description: Keep rewritten URLs as relative as the original resource URL was.

directives.name: PrivateNotVaryForIE
directives.description: Deprecated and ignored: in-place optimized resources are no longer browser-dependent, so they are never served as Cache-Control: private and never carry a Vary header.

directives.name: ProactiveResourceFreshening
directives.description: If true, allows proactive freshening of inputs to the resource when they are close to expiry.

directives.name: ProcessScriptVariables
directives.description: Evaluate nginx script variables ($var) in pagespeed directive arguments at request time: off, on (the LoadFromFile*, EnableFilters, DisableFilters, DownstreamCache* and ShardDomain directives) or all (every query- and directory-scoped option too). Settable once, at the top level.

directives.name: ProgressiveJpegMinBytes
directives.description: Minimum size in bytes for converting a jpeg to progressive

directives.name: ProxyAuth
directives.description: CookieName[=Value][:RedirectUrl] -- checks proxy requests for CookieName. If CookieValue is specified, checks for that. If Redirect is specified, a failure results in a redirection to that URL otherwise a 403 is generated.

directives.name: ProxySuffix
directives.description: Sets up a proxy suffix to be used when slurping.

directives.name: PubliclyCacheMismatchedHashesExperimental
directives.description: When serving a request for a .pagespeed. URL with the wrong hash, allow public caching based on the origin TTL.

directives.name: PurgeMethod
directives.description: HTTP method used for Cache Purge requests. Typically this is set to PURGE, but you must ensure that only authorized clients have access to this method.

directives.name: RateLimitBackgroundFetches
directives.description: Rate-limit the number of background HTTP fetches done at once

directives.name: RedisDatabaseIndex
directives.description: Redis server database index selection

directives.name: RedisReconnectionDelayMs
directives.description: Time to wait after unsuccessful reconnection before another attempt (ms)

directives.name: RedisServer
directives.description: Redis server to use in format: <host>[:<port>]

directives.name: RedisTimeoutUs
directives.description: Timeout for all Redis operations and connection (us)

directives.name: RedisTTLSec
directives.description: Redis key TTL to use (seconds)

directives.name: RefererStatisticsOutputLevel
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: RemoteConfigurationTimeoutMs
directives.description: Timeout for fetch of remote configuration file.

directives.name: RemoteConfigurationUrl
directives.description: URL of site from which to pull remote configuration files

directives.name: ReportUnloadTime
directives.description: Deprecated, no effect: the beacon is now sent on page-hide, which covers pre-onload abandonment without breaking bfcache.

directives.name: RequestOptionOverride
directives.description: Token passed in URL to enable pagespeed options in params.

directives.name: RespectVary
directives.description: Whether to respect Vary headers for resources. Vary is always respected for HTML.

directives.name: RespectXForwardedProto
directives.description: Whether to respect the X-Forwarded-Proto header.

directives.name: ResponsiveImageDensities
directives.description: Comma separated list of screen densities to target with ResponsiveImageFilter srcsets.

directives.name: RetainComment
directives.description: Retain HTML comments matching wildcard, even with remove_comments enabled

directives.name: RewriteDeadlinePerFlushMs
directives.description: Time to wait for resource optimization (per flush window) beforefalling back to the original resource for the request.

directives.name: RewriteLevel
directives.description: Base level of rewriting (PassThrough, CoreFilters)

directives.name: RewriteRandomDropPercentage
directives.description: The percentage of time that pagespeed should randomly drop an opportunity to optimize an image. The value should be an integer between 0 and 100 inclusive.

directives.name: RewriteUncacheableResources
directives.description: Allow optimization of uncacheable resources in the in-place rewriting mode.

directives.name: RslCapDirectoryHost
directives.description: Operator-mapped issuer directory host passed to the key provider (plane-split, never request-derived). Ignored by the v1 static-file provider; used by the follow-up network provider. Default empty.

directives.name: RslCapEnforcement
directives.description: Enable RSL-CAP capability-token enforcement: an Authorization: License token is validated and the verdict is mapped to an inline 401/402. Never settles/meters. Default off.

directives.name: RslCapIssuer
directives.description: Optional issuer pin: when set, an otherwise-authorized token whose iss != this value is rejected (401). Use when a directory host may serve multiple issuers. Default empty.

directives.name: RslCapKeyDirectoryAllowlist
directives.description: SSRF allowlist: comma-separated https origins the RSL-CAP warm-fetch may contact. Empty => warm-fetch disabled (fail-closed). Default empty.

directives.name: RslCapKeyDirectoryFile
directives.description: Path to a local JWKS file (the issuer's published key directory, copied locally by the operator) used to resolve RSL-CAP signing keys. v1: synchronous, no network fetch. Default empty.

directives.name: RslCapKeyDirectoryRefreshSec
directives.description: RSL-CAP warm-fetch refresh interval in seconds (clamped). Empty => default 3600. Default empty.

directives.name: RslCapKeyDirectoryUrl
directives.description: HTTPS URL of the issuer's JWKS directory, fetched off-request by a background thread and cached; the request path reads cache-only. Requires RslCapKeyDirectoryAllowlist and RslCapDirectoryHost. Default empty (no network fetch).

directives.name: RslCapRequestedLicense
directives.description: License id this route requires; a token must grant it (and the requested scope) to be authorized, else 402. Default empty.

directives.name: RslCapRequestedScope
directives.description: Scope this route requires; a token must grant it (and the requested license) to be authorized, else 402. Default empty.

directives.name: RunExperiment
directives.description: Run an experiment to test the effectiveness of rewriters.

directives.name: ServeRewrittenAvifUrlsToAnyAgent
directives.description: Serve rewritten .avif images to any user-agent

directives.name: ServeRewrittenWebpUrlsToAnyAgent
directives.description: Serve rewritten .webp images to any user-agent

directives.name: ServeStaleWhileRevalidateThresholdSec
directives.description: Threshold for serving serving stale responses while revalidating in background. 0 means don't serve stale content.Note: Stale response will be served only for non-html requests.

directives.name: ServeXhrAccessControlHeaders
directives.description: Serve access control headers with response headers

directives.name: ShardDomain
directives.description: Spreads optimized resource URLs for a domain across the listed shard domains.

directives.name: SharedMemoryLocks
directives.description: Use shared memory for internal named lock service

directives.name: ShmMetadataCacheCheckpointIntervalSec
directives.description: How often to checkpoint the shared memory metadata cache to disk. Set to 0 to turn off checkpointing.

directives.name: SlowFileLatencyUs
directives.description: Maximum time in microseconds to allow for file operations before logging and bumping a stat

directives.name: SlurpDirectory
directives.description: Directory from which to read slurped resources

directives.name: SlurpFlushLimit
directives.description: Set the maximum byte size for the slurped content to hold before a flush

directives.name: SlurpReadOnly
directives.description: Only read from the slurped directory, fail to fetch URLs not already in the slurped directory

directives.name: SslCertDirectory
directives.description: Directory to find SSL certificates.

directives.name: SslCertFile
directives.description: File with SSL certificates.

directives.name: StaticAssetCDN
directives.description: Configures serving of helper scripts from external URLs rather than from compiled-in versions via static handler.

directives.name: StaticAssetPrefix
directives.description: Where to serve static support files for pagespeed filters from.

directives.name: Statistics
directives.description: Whether to collect cross-process statistics.

directives.name: StatisticsDomains
directives.description: Access control for the per-host statistics page: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.

directives.name: StatisticsLogging
directives.description: Whether to log statistics if they're being collected.

directives.name: StatisticsLoggingChartsCSS
directives.description: Where to find an offline copy of the Google Charts Tools API CSS.

directives.name: StatisticsLoggingChartsJS
directives.description: Where to find an offline copy of the Google Charts Tools API JS.

directives.name: StatisticsLoggingFile
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: StatisticsLoggingIntervalMs
directives.description: How often to log statistics, in milliseconds.

directives.name: StatisticsLoggingMaxFileSizeKb
directives.description: Max size for statistics logging file.

directives.name: StatisticsPath
directives.description: Set the statistics path. Ex: /ngx_pagespeed_statistics

directives.name: StickyQueryParameters
directives.description: The token that must be set by the PageSpeedStickyQueryParameters query parameter/header in a request to enable the setting of cookies for all other PageSpeed query parameters/headers in the request. Blank means it is disabled.

directives.name: StrictAdminAccess
directives.description: OPT-IN, default off. When on, the admin, statistics, console and message handlers deny non-loopback clients unless an explicit *Domains allowlist is configured. The loopback decision uses the validated client connection IP, not the Host header. When off (default) access checks behave exactly as before.

directives.name: SupportNoScriptEnabled
directives.description: Support for clients with no script support, in filters that insert new javascript.

directives.name: TestOnlyPrioritizeCriticalCssDontApplyOriginalCss
directives.description: Stops the prioritize_critical_css filter from invoking its JavaScript that applies all the 'hidden' CSS at onload. Intended for testing.

directives.name: TestProxy
directives.description: Direct non-PageSpeed URLs to a fetcher, acting as a simple proxy. Meant for test use only

directives.name: TestProxySlurp
directives.description: If set, the fetcher used by the TestProxy mode will be a readonly slurp fetcher from the given directory

directives.name: TrackOriginalContentLength
directives.description: Add X-Original-Content-Length headers to rewritten resources

directives.name: UrlPrefix
directives.description: Removed option; the name is still accepted and ignored.

directives.name: UrlSigningKey
directives.description: Key used for signing .pagespeed resource URLs.

directives.name: UrlValuedAttribute
directives.description: Declares an extra element attribute that holds a URL, with the resource category (image, script, stylesheet, otherResource, hyperlink) it should be treated as.

directives.name: UseAnalyticsJs
directives.description: Log to analytics.js instead of ga.js with insert_ga.

directives.name: UseBlankImageForInlinePreview
directives.description: Use a blank image for inline preview

directives.name: UseExperimentalJsMinifier
directives.description: Deprecated and ignored: the legacy JavaScript minifier was removed; the tokenizer-based minifier is the only JavaScript minifier

directives.name: UseFallbackPropertyCacheValues
directives.description: If this is set to true, fallback values will be used from property cache if actual value is not present. Here fallback values means properties which are shared across all requests which have same url if query paramaters are removed. Example: http://www.test.com?a=1 and http://www.test.com?a=2 share same fallback properties though they are two different urls.

directives.name: UseNativeFetcher
directives.description: Use nginx's own event-driven fetcher for the resource fetches the module makes, instead of the built-in serf fetcher.

directives.name: UsePerVHostStatistics
directives.description: If true, keep track of statistics per VHost and not just globally

directives.name: WebBotAuth
directives.description: Enable observe-only Web-Bot-Auth (RFC 9421) request classification, surfaced as $x_verified_bot. Never blocks. Default off.

directives.name: WebBotAuthBotDetection
directives.description: Let a verified Web-Bot-Auth signature classify the request as an automated client for PageSpeed's own bot detection, so a signed agent is recognised even when it presents a browser user-agent. Suppresses the measurement beacons and lazyload for that request; never blocks it. Requires WebBotAuth. Default off (verdict stays observe-only).

directives.name: WebBotAuthDirectoryHost
directives.description: The signer directory's host identity: the warm-fetch cache key, paired with WebBotAuthKeyDirectoryUrl. Ignored by the local-file static provider. Never request-derived. Default empty.

directives.name: WebBotAuthKeyDirectoryAllowlist
directives.description: SSRF allowlist: comma-separated https origins (scheme://host[:port]) the warm-fetch may contact. Empty => warm-fetch disabled (fail-closed). Default empty.

directives.name: WebBotAuthKeyDirectoryFile
directives.description: Path to a local JWKS file (the signer's published key directory, copied locally by the operator) used to verify signatures. A1 v1: no network fetch. Default empty.

directives.name: WebBotAuthKeyDirectoryRefreshSec
directives.description: Warm-fetch refresh interval in seconds (clamped). Empty => default 3600. Default empty.

directives.name: WebBotAuthKeyDirectoryUrl
directives.description: HTTPS URL of the signer's JWKS directory, fetched off-request by a background thread and cached; the request path reads cache-only and never fetches. Requires WebBotAuthKeyDirectoryAllowlist and WebBotAuthDirectoryHost. Default empty (no network fetch).

directives.name: WebBotAuthPublicCounter
directives.description: Opt-in verified-crawl counter mode (experimental): off (default) | private | public. Enabling a non-off mode publishes a discoverable marker at /.well-known/webbotauth-counter; the exact document is gated by the PAGESPEED_WEB_BOT_AUTH_COUNTER_TOKEN env bearer token. Default off (endpoint invisible).

directives.name: WebBotAuthTelemetry
directives.description: Count verified/signed-agent requests in the opt-in web_bot_auth_verified_signed_requests statistic (and non-web-bot-auth signature material in web_bot_auth_other_signature_requests). Default off.

directives.name: WebBotAuthVerifiedBots
directives.description: Verified-bot registry: comma-separated keyid=name pairs.

directives.name: WebpAnimatedRecompressionQuality
directives.description: Quality for rewritten animated webp images [-1,100], 100 refers to best quality, -1 uses ImageRecompressionQuality.

directives.name: WebpQualityForSaveData
directives.description: Set quality for the images which will be optimized to lossy WebP format in the Save-Data mode. Use a value in [0,100] to explicitly set the quality. Use -1 to ignore the Save-Data header.

directives.name: WebpRecompressionQuality
directives.description: Quality for rewritten webp images [-1,100], 100 refers to best quality, -1 uses ImageRecompressionQuality.

directives.name: WebpRecompressionQualityForSmallScreens
directives.description: Quality for rewritten webp images for small screens. [-1,100], 100 refers to best quality, -1 falls back to WebpRecompressionQuality.

directives.name: XHeaderValue
directives.description: Set the value for the X-Mod-Pagespeed HTTP header
